trait.name: Tunneler
entries: The umber hulk can burrow through solid rock at half its {@variantrule Burrow Speed|XPHB} and leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The umber hulk makes three Rend attacks.

bonus.name: Confusing Gaze {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 14}, each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} The target can't take Reactions until the start of the umber hulk's next turn, and the target rolls {@dice 1d8} to determine what it does on its next turn:

items.entry: The target takes no action or {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} and uses all its movement to move in a random direction.
The target makes a melee attack against a random creature within its reach or does nothing if it can't make such an attack.
